name: dora-readiness
description: Get an EU financial entity ready for DORA, the Digital Operational Resilience Act (Regulation 2022/2554). Three deterministic stdlib scripts: a scope check for the 20 entity types, exclusions, the Article 16 simplified framework and critical ICT provider oversight; a major-incident classifier that applies the Delegated Regulation 2024/1772 thresholds, catches recurring incidents and runs the 2025/301 clock (initial 4h/24h, intermediate 72h, final one month, weekend rule); and a register of information check for Article 30 contract terms, exit plans and concentration risk. Ships cs-dora-officer agent, /cs-dora-readiness and /cs-dora-incident commands, 3 cited references and a major-incident runbook.
